# CIE Insider

> Free revision tools and paid script marking for Cambridge IGCSE Physics (0625, and the 9-1 graded 0972) and Cambridge International AS & A Level Physics (9702). Built by Rich Tyson, a physics teacher who marked 0625 and 9702 for Cambridge, from every examiner report Cambridge published for both syllabuses from 2021 to 2026. Independent: not affiliated with or endorsed by Cambridge International.

## Who runs it
- Rich Tyson, sole trader, UK. BSc Physics (Hons); PGCE Physics with Mathematics.
- Former Cambridge examiner for 0625 and 9702. Not currently contracted as an examiner.
- Contact: rich@cieinsider.com

## The papers (from the Cambridge syllabuses)
- 0625 Cambridge IGCSE Physics: Paper 1 Multiple Choice (Core), Paper 2 Multiple Choice (Extended), Paper 3 Theory (Core), Paper 4 Theory (Extended), Paper 5 Practical Test, Paper 6 Alternative to Practical.
- 0972 is the same syllabus content as 0625, graded 9-1 instead of A*-G: https://cieinsider.com/blog/is-0972-the-same-as-0625/
- 9702 Cambridge International AS & A Level Physics: Paper 1 Multiple Choice, Paper 2 AS Level Structured Questions, Paper 3 Advanced Practical Skills, Paper 4 A Level Structured Questions, Paper 5 Planning, Analysis and Evaluation.

## Paid
- Script marking: a full past paper you have attempted, marked against the published mark scheme by a former examiner, with what the examiner report said where it commented on your question. GBP 25 to 35 depending on the paper, or five for GBP 109. Back within a week or your money back. https://cieinsider.com/marked/
- The Maths Behind A Level Physics (9702): self-paced course on the numerical and unit skills 9702 assumes. GBP 39, one payment, 14-day refund. https://cieinsider.com/bridge/
- Terms, refunds and privacy: https://cieinsider.com/terms/
